home.tagline: Trade like a beast. Without risking a dime.
home.lead: A paper-trading bot with technical strategies and an AI that pushes back when it should, a daily crypto news radar and an on-chain wallet snoop. Everything in the open, no black boxes.
home.features.bot.title: Paper bot
home.features.bot.text: Moving-average crossover and RSI on real Binance candles. Every simulated order is logged with its reason and, with a key, Claude's thumbs-up (or reality check).
home.features.news.title: Crypto radar
home.features.news.text: Nine specialised sources, topic tags, a searchable archive and a daily AI-written digest. Catches up on its own every morning, before you do.
home.features.wallet.title: Web3 wallet
home.features.wallet.text: Balance of any EVM address on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base or BNB Chain. Snoop all you like, it's public.
home.coins.title: The usual suspects
home.coins.text: The same coins as 2021, now with live prices.
home.binance.title: Plugged into Binance
home.binance.text: Candles and prices come straight from the world's biggest exchange. The only fake thing here is the money.
dashboard.title: Market
dashboard.lead: Live prices over WebSocket and candles from Binance, global market from CoinGecko, sentiment from alternative.me. No keys, no strings attached.
dashboard.empty: The exchange isn't talking. Is the backend running?
bot.title: Trading bot
bot.lead: Paper trading: fake money, real prices. Every tick it checks every pair and writes down what it did and why. No excuses.
bot.resetConfirm: Clean slate? All trades go and you're back to the starting balance.
bot.llm: Ask Claude for a second opinion
bot.llmOff: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the backend: signals go through raw, nobody's checking.
bot.noTrades: Nothing's moved yet. Run a tick and get the party started.
bot.noDecisions: The bot's still warming up. No decisions yet.
news.title: News radar
news.lead: What’s cooking in crypto media, tagged by topic. With a key, Claude has the digest ready every morning, with your coffee.
news.empty: Nothing here yet. Hit “Refresh now” or wait for the beast's morning round.
wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.lead: Native balance of any EVM address. Read-only: nothing gets signed here, relax.
wallet.hint: Without WEB3_RPC_URL on the backend we use public nodes, and they get fussy about rate limits.
